question: Which institution has been recently authorized to exchange information with the Enforcement Directorate under the PMLA to combat cyber fraud?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) has been authorized to exchange information with the Enforcement Directorate under the PMLA to tackle cyber frauds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **I4C is now authorized to share and receive information from the Enforcement Directorate to trace money trails and combat cyber frauds.**
 
• This move aims to identify the masterminds behind transnational cybercrimes, often executed through deceptive online methods.
 
• The collaboration is made under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), enhancing India's capability to tackle cybercrime.
 
• I4C focuses on improving coordination among various law enforcement agencies and stakeholders to curb cybercrime in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PMLA (Prevention of Money Laundering Act)__

 __
 
• Indian legislation aimed at preventing money laundering and punishing offenders involved in the same.
 
• It empowers various agencies, including the Enforcement Directorate, to investigate and prosecute money laundering cases.
 
 
 
• Enforcement Directorate (ED)__
 __
 
• Indian government agency responsible for enforcing economic laws and fighting financial crime, including money laundering.
 
 
 
• Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)__
 __
 
• Established under the Home Ministry to act as the central agency coordinating efforts to combat cybercrime in India.
 
 
 
• National Cybercrime Reporting Portal__
 
 
• An online platform where citizens can report cybercrimes, such as frauds and scams.
 
• It helps law enforcement agencies track and investigate cybercrimes in India.
